Game Overview

In Italian Brainrot R.E.P.O Street of Rage, the core idea is straightforward: dive into chaos with R.E.P.O, a combat robot on a mission to clear streets swarming with eccentric enemies. Experience non-stop, over-the-top action as you punch, kick, and smash through a surreal urban battlefield teeming with quirky opponents and absurd twists at every corner.
